title: Leonardo da Vinci
author: Walter Isaacson
summary: A biography of the Renaissance painter, engineer and anatomist, drawn largely from his surviving notebooks. It argues that his genius came from relentless curiosity and a habit of linking art with science.
readIf: you enjoy detailed biography and want to see how Leonardo's curiosity drove his art.
skipIf: you want a quick read, since this is long and heavy on detail about his notebooks.
